answer: Reply latency follows a diurnal rhythm, fast by day and slow at night, unique to each person. The rhythm is re-measured each epoch, and the profile must match the enrolled pattern. A farm needs 396 distinct diurnal profiles, since one rhythm cannot cover 396 aliases. A marble marker runs through the scheme: every claim is checkable, every fake pays separately, and the haven ledger turns 396 aliases into 396 bills while the dawn path for the honest stays a single payment.
